summary: Bulk procurement of 180 temporary ModelRun seats with SCIM/SSO and BYOK KMS
description:
Issue summary: Request procurement and seat-provisioning for ModelRun (vendor) to support an external benchmarking sprint and internal POC.

Background: The ML Platform and Benchmarks teams need a short-term pool of seats to run distributed model evaluations and a customer-facing demo for partners. ModelRun offers a 6-month trial SKU that supports SCIM provisioning and an option to use a customer-managed KMS. Finance has requested a single invoice/PO rather than monthly billing.

Request: Procure 180 temporary ModelRun seats, provision an ephemeral seat pool (not tied to one org), enable SCIM via Okta, configure SAML SSO, and ensure BYOK support with our AWS KMS key policy. Assign billing to cost center ENG-ML-Infra. Desired provisioning date: 2026-03-10.

Requirements checklist:
- SCIM provisioning integration (Okta) ready and tested
- SAML-based SSO configured for redwood.com users
- BYOK KMS support validated and KMS key policy template provided to vendor
- Vendor security questionnaire completed and reviewed by Security team
- Single prepay invoice/PO with cost center and GL mapping
- Seat pool tagging and ephemeral allocation UI option (so seats can be assigned to teams and reclaimed)

Business justification: Short-term benchmarking and demos will accelerate sales demos and provide production-grade performance data for inference cost optimization. Seats are temporary but need swift provisioning to meet scheduled benchmark runs.

Notes: This is not for a private deployment. We must confirm ModelRun will not require storage of customer keys or secrets beyond KMS wrapping and will support our BYOK policy.
impact: Delaying procurement will push the benchmark window and external partner demo, which could delay sales follow-ups and the evaluation of model inference tradeoffs. Current workaround: teams are using small local sandboxes but cannot scale to replicate production loads.
license_term: 6-month trial with optional conversion to annual licensing
funding_method: Prepay via PO - Finance GL code required; request Finance contact: Maria Chang
documents_needed: W-9 or vendor tax form for ModelRun, Inc.
required_integrations: BYOK AWS KMS key policy support
